verdict.rationale: The product ships as an Agent Skills folder whose SKILL.md is agent-oriented instruction content that agents load automatically from its description, so an agent can consume it directly (gh-19, gh-22, gh-1). However, there is no evidence of an llms.txt or a separate agent-readable documentation endpoint, and the probe for a markdown docs version returned HTTP 404 (probe-1). missing for 10: llms.txt or llms-full.txt, a published agent-oriented docs URL, a working markdown docs endpoint, independent corroboration.
